snippet.title: POSTAL ADRENALIN - Teaser
snippet.description:
Postal Adrenalin is a collection of two total conversions.

The first mod, Postal 2: Call of Paradise, brings a dark atmosphere and a new storyline inspired by Postal 1.

The second mod, Postal 2: Outlaw, also features its own storyline, but has a more mischievous tone inspired by Postal 2.

Both mods take place in the town of Rockwood. Fight your way through a variety of enemies, escape pursuit in a car, and wipe out hordes of zombies in the most unexpected ways.

Welcome to Rockwood!
https://www.moddb.com/mods/postal-2-adrenalin
